dt: Nominations due Oct 24, 2026 (self-nominations not allowed); invited full applications due Dec 15, 2026
e: Nomination-based fellowship in physics, astronomy, chemistry and biochemistry, with research in a participating UCLA faculty member's lab. Candidates need a PhD conferred between Sept 2024 and Aug 2027 and must be a US citizen, permanent resident or J-1 visa eligible.
unv: The official page also gives Oct 31, 2026 in its nomination instructions; the overview and nomination form say Oct 24, 2026.
